title: What if India and Japan swapped places? 🔄
description:
What if India and Japan swapped places?

India is about nine times bigger than Japan by area. Dropped into East Asia, it would sit right off China's coast, facing Korea and Russia. Japan would land in South Asia, a small island nation between Pakistan, China and Bangladesh.

📌 Quick facts
• India: about 3.29 million km². Japan: about 378,000 km²
• Map is schematic
Figures are approximate and rounded.
